component.name: CONNECT 2 Control Center (unofficial)
component.summary: Experimental Linux control application for the LEWITT CONNECT 2

description.p: An independent, unofficial reconstruction of a control application for the LEWITT CONNECT 2 USB audio interface. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by LEWITT.

Status: experimental. The control protocol was derived from static analysis and has not been validated on real hardware; hardware writes are disabled. A simulated device is included for evaluation. Without administrator-installed USB permissions the application can only run in simulation mode.
